basics.name: Guilherme Vigneron de Oliveira
basics.label: Principal Technologist | QA & Software Testing Expert
basics.summary: As a seasoned Quality Assurance Engineer with over 15 years of experience, I elevate software quality through innovative testing strategies and automation. My relentless pursuit of excellence, global collaboration, and attention to detail ensure every project achieves the highest standards. I am passionate about advancing quality assurance and eager to bring my innovative strategies to a forward-thinking team.

work.name: AVEVA
highlights: Led the development and implementation of comprehensive test strategies, achieving significant increases in test coverage and reductions in defects.
Designed and implemented robust test automation frameworks using Selenium and C#, enhancing maintainability and efficiency.
Orchestrated automated and manual testing processes using Azure DevOps, improving deployment reliability.
Conducted critical performance testing with JMeter to optimize software performance.
Led cross-functional teams as a Scrum Master, fostering collaboration and driving increases in sprint velocity.
